q: What does Senseible's Expert Climate Audit cover, and when do I still need an accredited verifier?
title: Senseible Expert Climate Audit explained
short: The Expert Climate Audit is a one-time expert review of your climate reports by the Senseible team: emissions reporting, green finance reports, CBAM, BRSR, net-zero, decarbonisation and green transition reports. It costs ₹7,999 before GST, booked from your Subscription page. Where a rule names an accredited verifier, as CCTS and BRSR Core assurance do, you still appoint one.
audience: MSME owners deciding whether to pay for expert review

ul: Emissions reporting: your Scope 1, 2 and 3 records and the reports built from them.
Green finance reports: what you send a bank or lender for a green or sustainability-linked loan.
CBAM: the embedded emissions data an EU importer asks you for.
BRSR: the environment indicators in your Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report.
Net-zero and decarbonisation: your baseline, targets and reduction plan.
Green transition and similar climate reports.
p: The review is done independently by Senseible, with expert guidance. After payment the team contacts you to agree which report is in scope.

sections.h: Price and how to book it
ul: Price: ₹7,999 one-time, before GST. One audit per purchase.
Where: the Top up and services card on your Subscription page, next to invoice credits and Fast-track Verification.
Payment: UPI adds 18% GST. Card, netbanking or wallet through Razorpay adds a 4% platform fee, then 18% GST on the price plus fee.
The order shows on your Subscription page as Booked, then In progress, then Delivered.

sections.h: When you need an accredited verifier as well
ul: Your buyer or lender asks for limited or reasonable assurance on your Scope 1 and 2 figures.
You report BRSR Core indicators that need assurance or assessment under SEBI's framework.
Your plant is an obligated entity under India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme, where only a BEE accredited agency can verify.
You want to call a product footprint verified under ISO 14067.
p: In these cases the rule names who may sign, so appoint an accredited body. An audited, traceable record still cuts the verifier's time and the number of questions they send back.

sections.h: Expert Climate Audit or Fast-track Verification
p: Both are bought on the Subscription page. Fast-track Verification is priced per report at ₹2,999 before GST, with results in 24 to 72 hours, and you can buy up to 20 in one go. It speeds up the Verify step for a deadline. The Expert Climate Audit is a single one-time purchase at ₹7,999 before GST for an expert review of a whole report.
